goal: Fix solve_cascade's RewriteKey.name construction to use the dependent manifest's own ecosystem-native identity (via a newly threaded IdentityIndex) instead of PackageId::name(), so dual-identity cross-ecosystem rewrite targets resolve to the correct dependency-manifest key and apply_version_plan no longer aborts with DependencyNotFound.
architecture: Thread identity: &'a IdentityIndex through CascadeInput and an owned identity: IdentityIndex through Workspace (populated once in Workspace::load from graph.identity()), following the exact precedent of Track 1's tags: &TagIndex field. Both fields are added as scaffolding first, with mechanical fixups at every existing struct-literal construction site, then solve_cascade's single RewriteKey.name expression is changed to look up input.identity.native_name(&edge.to, eco) with a PackageId::name() fallback when no cross-ecosystem registration exists. Verification proceeds bottom-up: a dual-identity test and a fallback/regression test through the real run_cascade call path, a full-suite regression pass, and a real on-disk end-to-end apply_version_plan test.
